en.conclusion_source: DriveCompose jointly completes world-space background and canonical actor latents, preserving component identity and motion bindings for state-driven reuse. Shared scene context improves hidden geometry and appearance over task-adapted scene-latent and object-coupling controls. Fixed Gaussian assets support camera shifts, vehicle rotation, and human pose edits. Waymo reconstruction, paired surface metrics, and multidimensional real-edit ratings establish completion quality and state-driven reuse.
